entity.summary: Digital-asset trading platform within the Republic group, combining cryptocurrency and stablecoin trading with regulated tokenized-securities market infrastructure through affiliated United States and Canada-linked entities.
entity.notes: Current first-party disclosures identify The INX Digital Company, Inc. as a Canada-incorporated holding company and INX Digital, Inc. and INX Securities, LLC as United States-facing operating affiliates within Republic. A February 2026 delisting affected the INX Token specifically and is not treated as closure of the broader crypto and tokenized-asset platform. No exact public platform launch date or canonical predecessor-successor edge is asserted.

evidence.title: INX One digital-asset trading platform and legal disclosures
evidence.notes: Current first-party platform offers cryptocurrency, stablecoin, and tokenized real-world-asset trading and identifies the Canada-incorporated holding company, United States operating affiliates, and Republic ownership.

evidence.title: The INX Digital Company 2025 annual report
evidence.notes: Current regulatory filing describes continuing digital-asset platform development and operations. It also records the February 2026 INX Token delisting, which is limited to that token and does not establish platform shutdown.
